mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username FROM users WHERE username=#{username};

SELECT users.username, user_notification_preferences.is_enabled, notification_types.notification_type, notification_types.frequency, user_notification_preferences.last_update_time FROM user_notification_preferences JOIN users ON user_notification_preferences.user_id = users.user_id JOIN notification_types ON user_notification_preferences.notification_type_id = notification_types.notification_type_id WHERE username = #{username};

SELECT users.username, user_subscriptions.subscription_start_date, user_subscriptions.subscription_end_date, user_subscriptions.billing_period, user_subscriptions.auto_renewal, products.product_id, products.product_name FROM user_subscriptions JOIN users ON user_subscriptions.user_id = users.user_id JOIN products ON user_subscriptions.product_id = products.product_id WHERE username = #{username};
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET stripe_customer_id = #{stripeCustomerId} WHERE username = #{username};
UPDATE user_notification_preferences SET is_enabled = #{input.isEnabled} WHERE user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{input.username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_subscriptions (user_id, product_id, subscription_start_date, subscription_end_date, billing_period, auto_renewal) VALUES (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{input.username}, #{input.productId}, #{input.subscriptionStartDate}, #{input.subscriptionEndDate}, #{input.billingPeriod}, {input.autoRenewal});
